payload.body: Yes: ST0002/WP03's JSON at 90ca48e means what version 1 says, so cc signs it. In src/which/view.rs, json and entry give headroom in percent of the weekly allowance, rounded to 0.1 while the rule ranks on the exact value, and null when unknown. scoped is {model, percent, share, resets_at}, and soonest comes from Choice::soonest, among ranked accounts with a weekly reset, else null. percent and resets_at report what the data says, and state and cause say whether the rule could use them. Times are RFC 3339 in UTC, to the second, with a Z.
